channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Bezos backlash over Washington Post cuts
item.description: Hundreds of Washington Post journalists have been laid off as the paper faces ongoing financial losses and a major restructuring.

item.title: FactCheck: how many baby formula recall poisonings have been reported in the UK, which brands are on recall list and what’s the advice for parents?
item.description: The UK health watchdog says it’s received 36 reports of children suffering symptoms of toxin poisoning linked to baby formula.

item.title: Starmer apologises for ‘believing Mandelson’s lies’ over Epstein links
item.description: The Prime Minister ditched his planned speech to issue a lengthy apology in an attempt to diffuse fury among his own MPs about Peter Mandelson's appointment as US Ambassador.

item.title: ‘Starmer knew extent of Mandelson’s links to Epstein’ – Kemi Badenoch
item.description: We spoke to Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch who told us she didn't accept the Prime Minister's apology.

item.title: Inflation predicted to return to 2% as soon as April, says Bank of England
item.description: The Bank of England has said that inflation should get back to 2% - the official target - as soon as this April.

item.title: Trump signals support Starmer’s Chagos Islands deal in U-Turn
item.description: President Trump has signalled his support for Sir Keir Starmer's deal to hand the Chagos Islands to Mauritius having previously described the deal as an 'act of great stupidity'.

item.title: Reform UK unveil former Tory councillor as party’s new Welsh leader
item.description: Nigel Farage is clearly hoping voters' unhappiness with the UK government will pay dividends for Reform in the Welsh parliament elections in May.

item.title: RSS Discovery: Aboard research ship monitoring impact of climate change
item.description: We mostly focus on things getting hotter with climate change. But out in the Atlantic right now, a British research vessel is studying how changes could actually lead to winters getting much, much colder for the UK.

item.title: Inquiry finds lives could have been saved in deadliest small boat Channel
item.description: An inquiry into the deadliest Channel crossing on record has concluded that some of the 31 victims could have been saved.

item.title: Millions of Epstein files expose abuse hidden behind luxurious lifestyle
item.description: Among millions of pages in the Epstein files, there were more than 2,000 videos detailing the everyday life and relationships of the convicted sex offender. We have reviewed hundreds of hours of the latest files uploaded without any accompanying information. The images, many of a sexual nature, give a glimpse of the late billionaire's luxury lifestyle.
